test_FrozenEstimator: test the sklearn.frozen.FrozenEstimator meta-estimator to skip fitting a pre-fitted model in a pipeline
test_FixedThresholdClassifier: test the sklearn.model_selection.FixedThresholdClassifier with a frozen estimator and custom decision threshold
test_ExtraTreesClassifier: test the sklearn.ensemble.ExtraTreesClassifier with missing values in the input data

test_validate_data: test the sklearn.utils.validation.validate_data function to validate and route input data with feature names
